plan.purpose: Exploratory 10-lane ubusd matrix after bounded batching; four paired blocks, no formal superiority verdict
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: RSS diagnostic only, not precise peak or PSS
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: Every lane and CPU/mean/p50/p95/p99 reported separately; C/R89/before/candidate identities frozen; parallel CPU uses one outer interval; diagnostic RSS not PSS or proof of total-memory superiority.
plan.hypothesis: Earlier bounded sends improve p50 and reduce common batch-buffer capacity, while CPU remains below C and R89; validate frame order and partial writes separately.
plan.retention_rule: Any correctness failure rejects; report all CPU/latency changes against every side, never replace formal confirmation with this pilot.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 10 lanes
memory_note: End-of-matrix proc counters; not PSS, precise RSS, per-lane peak or whole-system memory
